segments.he:
ב.

עַל־יְדֵי לִמּוּד פּוֹסְקִים עַד שֶׁיֵּדַע לְהוֹרוֹת הוֹרָאוֹת, עַל־יְדֵי זֶה גּוֹרֵם פְּקִידָה לְכַמָּה עֲקָרוֹת.
segments.en: One who conducts himself with abstinence and afterwards retracts from it, falls into additional lust, more than he had before his abstention.

segments.he:
ד.

לִמּוּד הַפּוֹסְקִים מְבַטְּלִין הִרְהוּרֵי עֲבוֹדָה זָרָה.
segments.en: Abstinence from sexual relations is reckoned as a fast.

segments.he:
ה.

כְּשֶׁאֵיזֶהוּ רָשָׁע נִתְגַּדֵּל, אֲזַי קָשֶׁה לְחַדֵּשׁ אֵיזֶהוּ סְבָרָא בַּפּוֹסְקִים. גַּם דִּבְרֵי הַדַּיָּנִים אֵינָם נִשְׁמָעִים בְּאָזְנֵי הַבַּעֲלֵי־דִינִים.
segments.en: The sickness of coughing up blood is due to canceling  (or refraining)  from the sexual relations of the night of  (one's wife's)  ritual immersion.
By learning the codes of Jewish law until one is able to render halachic decisions, one causes numerous barren women to conceive.
Through studying the  Shulchan Aruch (the primary book of Jewish law), one comes to fear [of Heaven].
Studying codifiers of Torah law nullifies thoughts of idol worship.
